data.body: Close refused at 13:10 PST 2026-11-12: the 3 mechanism-ok markers on the lock-file listing in event_commit_git.py named this ticket as their sunset ticket, and the close gate will not close a ticket a live marker points at. The ratchet requires every marker to name an open retiring ticket, so the fix is to remove the mechanism: follow-up commit ff26816be38 drops the listing; the timeout ERROR now names the git dir and points at the runbook section, which carries the find command. 66 tests pass, mechanism ratchet exits 0. make verify running, then Gerrit, then the close.
